definitions.explanation: A word or phrase associated with a particular season, used as a requirement in traditional haiku poetry.

examples.japanese: {俳句|はいく}には{季語|きご}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{桜|さくら}は{春|はる}の{季語|きご}です。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are a spring seasonal word.

examples.japanese: {季語|きご}を{入|い}れないと{俳句|はいく}にならない。
examples.english: Without a seasonal word, it doesn't count as haiku.
